paper: Bidirectional Predictive Coding for Multi-Step Action Anticipation
abstract: We propose a bidirectional predictive coding framework for action anticipation in egocentric video. Our model encodes visual observations into a latent representation using a bidirectional transformer. A forward predictor forecasts the next action state, while a backward predictor refines the latent representation using future context. Both predictors are trained with a contrastive loss that encourages temporal consistency. The system fails when actions have high variability and the forward predictor's uncertainty propagates to the backward pass.
